description: Samsung One UI-inspired live activity bar for the Windows taskbar, with media controls, timers, sports scores, weather, and system status.
notes: Keep nowbar.exe and nowbar-settings.exe in the same application directory.
Settings are stored under %APPDATA%\NowBar; logs and other local data are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NowBar, outside the Scoop app directory.
The built-in updater replaces the application executables. Use scoop update now-bar to keep the Scoop-managed copy in control.
Requires Windows 10 version 1809 or later, or Windows 11.
